primary_source.name: Livshyts-Paouris-Pivovarov, On sharp bounds for marginal densities of product measures
primary_source.exact_hypothesis_used: independent product probability density with each one-dimensional factor L-infinity norm <=1
primary_source.exact_conclusion_used: one-dimensional orthogonal marginal density <=sqrt(2), hence ||p_{ell^T Y+beta}||_inf <=sqrt(2)/||ell||_2

quadratic_density_source_audit.name: Banks-Garza Vargas-Kulkarni-Srivastava, arXiv:2005.08930, Section 2 Theorem 2.1
quadratic_density_source_audit.scope: bilinear-plus-affine q(X,Y) with independent arrays; scalar non-Gaussian theorem has content only for rank(Z)>3 and retains singular-value dependence

partner_result.application: Applied conditionally with residual density M(y)=1/(2|L(y)|), then averaged using the LPP-derived half-negative-moment bound.

main_bound: If a physical pivot a!=0 has a selected Schur complement S with S_ii=0 and transverse row norm s>0, then the full ambient quadratic form has ||p_Q||_inf <=2^(9/4)/sqrt(|a|s); for one transverse coordinate, <=4/sqrt(|a|s).
continuity_status: absolute continuity and essential L-infinity bound proved; continuity not claimed for the dependence-safe branch
mechanism_change: YES: switched from prior cross-block/group-selection mechanism to translation-uniform fractional trace through a zero Schur row
first_unproved_step: Extend the exact zero-Schur-row bound to quantitatively small nonzero S_ii, or obtain an aggregate grouped-coordinate version before fixed-row selection.
next_step: Study d X_i^2+2L X_i inside the outer square-smoothing interface and seek a uniform interpolation from d=0 to the already-paid nonzero-pivot/ridge branches.
